parameters.content:
## SEO Agent — Site Kickoff (2026-10-19)
`POST /webhook/seo-site-kickoff` (header X-API-Key, credential **SEO API Key**): `{ domain | site_id, jobs?, force?, dry_run?, request_id? }` (`jobs`: only these, e.g. leaving out what the customer already ran today) → 202 at once. Then, for a website the engine tracks and that is not paused, each weekly job it has switched on starts through its workflow's own **Manual Run**, one after the other, in Monday's order: AI visibility → backlinks (the full check) → AI growth → the Content Cadence → the Link Builder. Their reports arrive through the website's own callback, and each run records its spend under `schedule:<mode>` (the company's autopilot). Once per website (`seo_cache` `kickoff:<site_id>`, written before the first start); `force: true` starts it again. `dry_run: true` starts only AI Growth (no Bing / IndexNow submission) and the Content Cadence (plans, writes nothing) and records nothing.
